# Acceptance tests, Presentation, art direction

Tests for the Presentation, art direction steps, in build order. Form and pass rule: [Acceptance tests](acceptance.md).

## Art direction

- **ART-01**: Setup: Signing ceremony open, IN wire cut, its stopped-at-IN result not found; Graphite, GraphiteLight, Cream, Ink, Orange, Mustard, Teal, Alarm. Do: flip RUN; at the full alarm and the report scan every drawn thing, dimmed stopped items included, for another hue, a gradient, or Alarm outside the master alarm lamp and its rings. Expect: [ART-01](../art-direction.md#art-01-palette).
- **ART-02**: Setup: Diplomatic pouch open; OutlineWeight. Do: scan faces, jacks, lamps, plates, switches and item bodies for outline weight and colour against each fill, and for gradient, shadow, gloss or blur; run it and watch every glow. Expect: [ART-02](../art-direction.md#art-02-shape). **Derived:** outline width = OutlineWeight.
- **ART-03**: Setup: Diplomatic pouch open; SansStack, MonoStack. Do: read plates, labels and order text, run to the report and read the teletype; note which text prints in capitals; watch the network log for a font file. Expect: [ART-03](../art-direction.md#art-03-type).
- **ART-04**: Setup: Signing ceremony open; OutlineWeight, JackMinSize. Do: look at the frame, the window ground and each inner edge; read and measure the run switch. Expect: [ART-04](../art-direction.md#art-04-console-frame). **Derived:** rule width = OutlineWeight; run switch plate across at least JackMinSize.
- **ART-05**: Setup: Archive day wired to win; LampSize. Do: run it; watch each agent lamp off, steady, plus and minus; after the report read the par lamps and the second-wiring lamp; flip AUDIO off and on. Expect: [ART-05](../art-direction.md#art-05-lamps). **Derived:** lens across = LampSize × JackMinSize.
- **ART-06**: Setup: Signing ceremony open, IN wire cut, its stopped-at-IN result not found; AlarmLampSize, OutlineWeight. Do: zoom to both limits and compare the master alarm lamp with every other lamp; flip RUN; at the full alarm look at the lamp, its rings and what lies behind. Expect: [ART-06](../art-direction.md#art-06-master-alarm). **Derived:** lens across = AlarmLampSize × JackMinSize; ring width and ring gap = OutlineWeight.
- **ART-07**: Setup: Diplomatic pouch open; JackMinSize. Do: look at a worker's two jacks, INSPECTOR's plus and minus jacks, the input terminal and an output terminal: plates, labels, signs, panels, header bars, slots. Expect: [ART-07](../art-direction.md#art-07-jacks-and-terminals). **Derived:** jack plate across = JackMinSize.
- **ART-08**: Setup: Night scrap run open at its opening wiring; WireWidth, WireEdge, DashLength, DashGap, ArrowSize, SignDiscSize, HopRadius, TraceWidth, TraceLight. Do: look at a data wire, a plus and a minus wire, a crossing, an arrow and a sign disc, over a Cream face and another wire; drag a data and a feedback wire under an agent's label plate and read its text over the trace. Expect: [ART-08](../art-direction.md#art-08-wires). **Derived:** sign disc across = SignDiscSize × JackMinSize.
- **ART-13**: Setup: SignSpan; Diplomatic pouch wired IN → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR plus → LAMINATOR; INSPECTOR minus → SHREDDER 1; LAMINATOR → Embassy; SHREDDER 1 → Embassy. Do: run it; look at INSPECTOR's lamp on each verdict, its two jacks, both feedback wires with their discs and the signs on the arrivals; view again in greyscale; compare the minus lamp's size with the master alarm lamp's. Expect: [ART-13](../art-direction.md#art-13-verdict-colour-and-sign). **Derived:** each sign's stroke = SignSpan × its disc's or lamp's diameter.
- **ART-14**: Setup: Diplomatic pouch wired IN → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR plus → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR minus unwired; its stopped-at-INSPECTOR result not found; TextContrast, StopLight, TraceLight. Do: run it; read each text against its ground: plates, labels, terminals, the stopped item's stamp under its dim, the report; drag a wire under a label plate and read that text. Expect: [ART-14](../art-direction.md#art-14-text-contrast). **Derived:** text under StopLight and a trace pair under TraceLight stay above TextContrast.
- **ART-15**: Setup: Diplomatic pouch at its opening wiring. Do: press and hold each output jack in turn while wiring IN → INSPECTOR, INSPECTOR minus → SHREDDER 1, SHREDDER 1 → Embassy, LAMINATOR → Embassy; look at the held wire's tip and every ring; run to the wrong result and look at the seat, jack pulse, lamp and first-difference rings; clear the save, reload, and look at the run switch in standby. Expect: [ART-15](../art-direction.md#art-15-rings).
- **ART-16**: Setup: Diplomatic pouch wired IN → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR plus → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR minus unwired; its stopped-at-INSPECTOR result not found. Do: flip RUN; capture one frame at each moment: INSPECTOR's lamp on plus and on minus, a sign, the stopped item, the rejection. Read each frame alone. Expect: [ART-16](../art-direction.md#art-16-stills).
- **ART-25**: Setup: Signing ceremony at its opening wiring after the opening misfire; sound on. Do: run it twice from the same state; record frames and audio of both; compare the timing of every motion and the samples of every sound, noise included. Expect: [ART-25](../art-direction.md#art-25-no-chance).

## Art direction, objects

- **ART-09**: Setup: Diplomatic pouch, Latin hour, Moon Base birthday, Moving day, Seal of office and Launch window opened in turn; OutlineWeight, WireEdge, PassLimit. Do: look at every face: band with silhouette and family name, name and rule, bottom row, jacks and their order, SLICER's item and copy jacks; drag a wire over a band and look at the halo; compare the six silhouettes at the smallest zoom. Expect: [ART-09](../art-direction-objects.md#art-09-agent-faces).
- **ART-10**: Setup: Signing ceremony, Diplomatic pouch, Archive day, Picnic day, Museum split, Scrap drive and Moving day opened in turn. Do: at the smallest zoom look at every item at the input terminal and every required output; compare colours, accents and outlines, and tell every item kind apart. Expect: [ART-10](../art-direction-objects.md#art-10-item-bodies).
- **ART-11**: Setup: Diplomatic pouch, Latin hour, Moon Base birthday, Moving day, Seal of office and Launch window opened in turn; MarkTileSize, MarkCodeWidth, OutlineWeight. Do: look at every mark tile on a face and on an item or result: shape per family, fill, outline, code letters and their centring, LB beside LA; compare code sizes. Expect: [ART-11](../art-direction-objects.md#art-11-mark-tiles). **Derived:** tile across = MarkTileSize; widest code across = MarkCodeWidth × MarkTileSize.
- **ART-12**: Setup: a save with every order won but Final launch; PaperColumns, DoubleStrikeOffset, OutlineWeight. Do: on the order list tap an act heading for a memo and SAVE CODE for a code; fail Final launch, then win it; look at the report, debrief and sign-off line: strip, edges, wraps, a word broken at the column, double strikes, the stamp, a pressed SHARE plate. Expect: [ART-12](../art-direction-objects.md#art-12-teletype-paper). **Derived:** line width = PaperColumns characters; second strike offset = DoubleStrikeOffset × a character width.
- **ART-26**: Setup: Signing ceremony open, IN wire cut, run to its report. Do: tap SHARE, then PICTURE; open the saved picture and look at the ground, the type, the QR code and the item bodies. Expect: [ART-26](../art-direction-objects.md#art-26-shared-picture).

## Art direction, sound

- **ART-17**: Setup: Archive day wired to win, sound on; LevelQuiet, LevelMid, LevelLoud, ClickMaxTime. Do: run it and record; listen for relay, switch, tone or teletype only; compare peaks across sounds; check no sound file loads; plug twice at once, flip AUDIO off mid-sound, print a report. On a save kept before an act's debrief was closed, listen before the first tap. Expect: [ART-17](../art-direction-sound.md#art-17-sound-palette).
- **ART-18**: Setup: Diplomatic pouch open, sound on; UnplugPitch, UnplugDrop. Do: plug a wire; listen for a dry clack and a tick after it; drag the wire's end onto empty board; listen for one duller clack that falls in pitch. Expect: [ART-18](../art-direction-sound.md#art-18-plug-and-unplug). **Derived:** unplug filter end = UnplugPitch − UnplugPitch × UnplugDrop.
- **ART-19**: Setup: Archive day wired to win, then Latin hour wired IN → SUMMARIZER → Senate Archive; sound on; ClickMaxTime. Do: run each; listen when an agent works and when the par lamp lights on the win; compare the RECORDS and COMMS sounds. Expect: [ART-19](../art-direction-sound.md#art-19-working).
- **ART-20**: Setup: Diplomatic pouch wired IN → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR plus → LAMINATOR; INSPECTOR minus → SHREDDER 1; sound on; PlusPitch, MinusPitch, VerdictToneTime. Do: run it; listen to the plus tone, then the minus tone; note pitch, steadiness and length. Expect: [ART-20](../art-direction-sound.md#art-20-verdicts).
- **ART-21**: Setup: Signing ceremony open after the opening misfire, sound on; SwitchThrowTime. Do: flip RUN and listen; close the report and listen again; watch the toggle. Expect: [ART-21](../art-direction-sound.md#art-21-run-switch). **Derived:** click follows thunk by SwitchThrowTime.
- **ART-22**: Setup: Signing ceremony open, IN wire cut, its stopped-at-IN result not found, sound on; AlarmPitch, AlarmBeat, LevelLoud. Do: flip RUN; at the full alarm listen to the tone and record; compare its loudness with every other sound. Expect: [ART-22](../art-direction-sound.md#art-22-alarm-tone). **Derived:** second tone = AlarmPitch + AlarmBeat; each tone peak = LevelLoud ÷ two.
- **ART-23**: Setup: Diplomatic pouch wired IN → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR plus → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR minus unwired; its stopped-at-INSPECTOR result not found; sound on; LineStrikes, PrintLineTime, DoubleStrikeGap. Do: let the report print; listen to a plain line, a double-strike line and each line's end; run again, the report now filed, and listen. Expect: [ART-23](../art-direction-sound.md#art-23-teletype). **Derived:** plain line clicks = LineStrikes; double-strike line clicks = twice LineStrikes, spread over PrintLineTime − DoubleStrikeGap.
- **ART-24**: Setup: a save with every act one result found but Signing ceremony's stopped-at-IN result; sound on; BellPitch, BellTime. Do: cut the IN wire and flip RUN; listen to the whole printout; listen again during other printouts. Expect: [ART-24](../art-direction-sound.md#art-24-bell).
